create_continuous_binned_tokenizer: create a ContinuousBinnedTokenizer instance with a list of float bin values for trajectory tokenization
encode_trajectory_with_tokenizer: encode a 3D trajectory tensor into one-hot tokenized tokens using the ContinuousBinnedTokenizer encode method
decode_tokenized_trajectory: decode a 4D one-hot tokenized trajectory tensor back to continuous values using the decode method
create_tokenizer_from_dataset: create a ContinuousBinnedTokenizer from a training dataset using the class create factory method
check_discrete_property: check the discrete property of the ContinuousBinnedTokenizer to confirm it returns True for discrete tokenization
